text: 印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃8日在北马鲁古省中哈马黑拉县纬达贝工业园主持11个中资矿业下游化项目启动仪式。这些项目总投资约102亿美元，涉及动力电池、镍钴材料、电解铝、新能源工程机械及商用车制造等领域。普拉博沃还现场见证了园区中企电动汽车电池首次出口仪式。他表示，纬达贝工业园累计投资额已达200多亿美元，未来还计划增加70亿美元投资。该园区自开发以来已创造超过10万个就业岗位。印尼与中国合作让两国关系更加紧密，将为两国人民带来更多福祉。（新华社）
text_en: Indonesian President Prabowo on the 8th presided over the launch ceremony of 11 Chinese-invested mining downstream projects in the Weda Bay Industrial Park in Central Halmahera Regency, North Maluku Province. The projects involve a total investment of about $10.2 billion and cover areas including power batteries, nickel-cobalt materials, electrolytic aluminum, and new energy engineering machinery and commercial vehicle manufacturing. Prabowo also witnessed on site the first export ceremony of Chinese enterprises' electric vehicle batteries from the park. He said the cumulative investment in Weda Bay Industrial Park has reached more than $20 billion, with plans to add another $7 billion in investment in the future. Since development began, the park has created more than 100,000 jobs. Cooperation between Indonesia and China has brought the two countries closer and will bring more benefits to the two peoples. (Xinhua News Agency)
